༄༅/ /zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog ser skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od ces

bya ba bzhugs so/ / rin chen shog ser skor/ zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs pa'i nyi ma shin tu rmad byung gsal gyur pa/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sna tshogs rol pa ston mdzad cing*/ /mdzad pa'i 'phro 'dus 'gro ba yongs la rjes gzigs nas/ /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings gzhol bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mdzad pa ma lus mthar phyin nas/ skye bo rtag par 'dzin rnams gdul bya'i phyir/ / grong khyer dam pa shin tu rmad byung ba/ /rtsa mchog grong gshegs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin sngar nas shes zin te/ /'jig rten chos la snying po med pa'i phyir/ /da ni mi rtag sgyu ma'i lus 'dor bas/ /gcig tu phan pa'i gdams ngag bshad kyis nyon/ /tshe 'dir bden par bzung yang bslu bslu 'dra/ /mi rtag snying po med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /yid brtan med ces nges par rtogs byas nas/ /de ring nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig / rtag pa med pa'i mdza' bshes mgron po 'dra/ /re zhig 'dus kyang myur du 'bral bas na/ /sgyu ma'i grogs la chags sems rab spangs te/ /gtan du phan pa dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /bsags kyang 'jog pa'i nor rdzas sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis longs spyod pas/ /rang dbang yod dus bsod nams sbyin pa'i tshogs/ /phyi ma'i lam rgyags da lta grabs mdzod cig /brtsigs kyang 'jig pa'i khang khyim g.yar po 'dra/ /sdod pa'i dbang med 'gro ba'i gnas skabs yod/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas la chags sred rab spangs te/ /da lta nyid nas dben pa'i gnas brten cing*/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /don med chags sdang 'bar ba'i me dpung can/ /phan tshun 'thab rtsod 'khon 'dzin rab spangs la/ /da lta nyid nas rang gis sems thul cig /snying po med pa'i bya ba sgyu ma 'dra/ /re zhig brtson yang mtha' ma 'bras bu med/

/tshe 'di'i bya bzhag 'jig rten chos spangs la/ /da lta nyid nas thar pa'i lam tshol cig /dal 'byor lus rnyed rin chen gru bo 'dra/ /sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol ba'i stobs yod pas/ /le lo snyoms las sgyid lugs sems bor la/ /da lta nyid nas brtson pa'i stobs bskyed cig /dam pa'i bla ma 'jigs sa'i skyel ma 'dra/ /'khor ba'i dgra las skyob pa'i ded dpon la/ /sgo gsum zol med sri zhu chen po yis/ /da lta nyid nas mchod cing bsten par mdzod/ /zab mo'i gdams pa bdud rtsi'i sman dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs nad rnams gso ba'i mchog yin pas/ /rgyud la brten cing legs par goms pa yis/ /da lta nyid nas klong du 'gyur bar mdzod/ / bslab gsum rnam dag yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /'di phyir bde zhing mthar thug legs pa'i lam/ /byang chub zhi ba dam pa thob pas na/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /sna tshogs thos pa rin chen sgron me 'dra/ /gti mug sel zhing thar lam snang bar byed/ /ye shes mig 'byed phan bde'i 'od 'phro bas/ /da lta nyid nas phyogs ris med par mdzod/ /legs par bsam pa gser mkhan mkhas pa 'dra/ /yin min the tshom sgro 'dogs kun gcod pas/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsam byung shes rab kyis/ /da lta nyid nas khong du chud par mdzod/ /sgom pa'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i ro myong 'dra/ /thos bsam don sgom nyon mongs nad kun zhi/ /spros pa'i mtsho brgal snying po'i pha rol phyin/ /da lta nyid nas nags su bsgom par mdzod/ /lta ba'i rang bzhin dri med nam mkha' 'dra/ / mtho dman rgya chad phyogs lhung kun dang bral/ / yangs dog med cing smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /da lta nyid nas rtogs pa'i thabs mdzod cig /sgom pa'i rang bzhin ri bo rgya mtsho 'dra/ /'pho 'gyur me da cing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /rnam g.yeng spros pa'i mtshan ma kun zhi ba|/da lta nyid nas ji bzhin bsgom par mdzod/

/spyod pa'i rang bzhin skye bo mkhas pa 'dra/ /dus su babs dang gang phan gnas skabs shes/ /chags thogs blang dor dgag sgrub sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /da lta nyid nas gzung 'dzin grol bar mdzod/ /'bras bu'i rang bzhin ded dpon nor lon 'dra/ /rang nyid 'byor pas gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /re dang dogs med ngang gis blo bde ba/ /da lta nyid nas thob phyir 'bad par mdzod/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' 'dra/ / nam mkha'i rang bzhin sems nyid gnyug ma'i don/ /don la gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po ru/ /da lta nyid nas nges par rtogs par mdzod/ /sna tshogs chos rnams me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /snang bas stongs te logs na stong pa med/ /gcig dang tha dad ma brtag nyams dga' bar/ /da lta nyid nas nges par mkhyen par mdzod/ /gzung ba'i yul la 'dzin pa rmi lam 'dra/ /don la gnyis med bag chags gnyis snang ste/ de yang blos btags rang gi ngo bos stong*/ /da lha nyid nas gnyis med mkhyen par mdzod/ /'khor 'das rang bzhin sgyu ma'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /bzang ngan snang yang ngo bo mnyam pa nyid/ /thams cad ma skyes nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /da lta nyid nas nges par mkhyen par mdzod/ /'khrul snang bde sdug sprul pa'i rang bzhin 'dra/ /dge sdig rgyu 'bras so sor shar dus nas/ /rang bzhin ma skyes ngo bor 'pho 'gyur med/ /da lta nyid nas nges par mkhyen par mdzod/ / blos btags chos rnams byis pa'i rtsod pa 'dra/ /don la mi gnas rtog pas rab phye nas/ /bzang ngan grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin so sor zhen/ /da lta nyid nas mnyam nyid mkhyen par mdzod/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa rin chen gter dang 'dra/ /mi zad gong du 'phel zhing 'byor pa'i rgyu/ /tha ma mchog 'bring bsod nams zhing rnams la/ /da lta nyid nas ci 'os sbyin par mdzod/ /tshul khrims dri med shing rta bzang po 'dra/ /mngon mtho nges legs grong khyer bgrod pa'i stegs/

/sdom dang chos sdud sems can don byed rnams/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /bzod pa mtsho chen mi 'khrugs mchog dang 'dra//gnod pas mi 'phrog dka' thub nang nas mchog /sdug bsngal dang len snying rje'i chos sems sogs/ /da lta nyid nas goms shing 'dris par mdzod/ /brtson 'grus me chen phung po 'bar ba 'dra/ /mi mthun phyogs bsregs dge la yang dag spro/ /sgyid lugs snyoms las le lo med pa yis/ / da lta nyid nas thar lam sgrubs par mdzod/ /bsam gtan mi g.yo ri rgyal mchog dang 'dra/ /dmigs pas mi bskyod yul la yengs pa med/ /gang la mnyam gzhag gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs pa/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la goms par mdzod/ /shes rab rgya chen nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /gti mug mun sel dam chos snang bar byed/ /thar gling mchog spel nyes pa'i chu gter skems/ /da lta nyid nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ /thabs mkhas ded dpon nor bu len pa 'dra/ /sdug bsngal mtsho brgal bde chen gling 'grod nas/ /sku gsum mchog thob don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /da lta nyid nas thabs kyis gzhan phan mdzod/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa'i dpa' bo 'dra/ /nyon mongs dpung 'joms byang chub lam la dgod/ /dge tshogs mthar phyin bar chad med pas na/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /smon lam yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'dra/ /'dod dgu lhun grub bde chen ngang gis 'phel/ /zhi la sems gzhol yid la re ba skong*/ /da lta nyid nas rlabs chen 'debs par mdzod/ /ye shes mkha' la chu 'dzin 'khrigs par 'dra/ /ting 'dzin gzungs sprin phan bde'i char 'beb pas/ / 'gro kun dge tshogs lo tog legs par bskrun/ /da lta nyid nas thob phyir 'bad par mdzod/ /thabs dang shes rab bzhon pa bzang po 'dra/ /srid zhir mi ltung rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /lam lnga mthar phyin sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /da lta nyid nas 'bad pas bsgrub par mdzod/

/byang chub phyogs chos lam bzang chen po 'dra/ /dus gsum 'phags rnams snga phyi'i gshegs shul te/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi sogs sum cu bdun/ /da lta nyid nas bsgom phyir brtson par mdzod/ /gzhan yang byams pa pha ma bzang po 'dra/ / 'gro drug bu la thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /brtse bas don byed phan pa rtag tu sgrub/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la goms par mdzod/ /snying rje rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' 'dra/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gi sdug bsngal bzhin/ /bral bar 'dod pa brtson pa'i ya lad can/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /dga' ba rigs kyi rje dpon bzang po 'dra/ /gzhan dag dge bas rang nyid blo bde bas/ /ched du bkod pa bzhin du rjes yi rang*/ / da lta nyid nas mchog du goms par mdzod/ /btang snyoms rang bzhin snyoms pa'i sa gzhi 'dra/ /nye ring chags sdang med cing zug ngu bral/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i ngang nas bde ba che/ /da lta nyid nas rang bzhin goms par mdzod/ / byang chub sems gnyis ded dpon dam pa 'dra/ /dge kun thar gling 'grod pa'i kha lo ba/ /srid pas mi skyo gzhan don phun sum tshogs/ /da lta nyid nas yang yang bskyed par mdzod/ /mos pa rgya mtsho chu gter chen po 'dra/ /dge bas gang zhig snga phyi ro gcig 'dzin/ /dus kun mi nyams dad pa'i rlabs g.yo ba/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /bsngo ba mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod dang 'dra/ /chos dbyings bsngos pas mi nyams gong du 'phel/ / chos sku ro gcig gzugs sku lhun gyis grub/ /da lta nyid nas 'khor gsum dag par mdzod/ /rjes su yi rang nam mkha'i khams dang 'dra/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dmigs med rlom sems bral/ /mi g.yo rang tu dwangs pa'i rnam pa can/ /da lta nyid nas yang yang brten par mdzod/ /gzhan yang dran pa lcags kyu bzang po 'dra/ /sems kyi glang po ma thul myos pa 'dzin/ / nyes las rab ldog rang bzhin dge la sbyor/

/da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /shes bzhin ma yengs mel tshe bzang po 'dra/ /mi dge'i rkun pos glags skabs mi rnyed cing*/ /dge ba'i nor mang srung la zhugs pas na/ /da lta nyid nas nges par brten par mdzod/ /bag yod lcags ri 'thas bzang (< a > 'obs bzang ) bskor ba 'dra/ /nyon mongs chom rkun tshogs kyis mi 'phrogs shing*/ /las kyi dgra las rgyal ba'i dpung tshogs can/ /da lta nyid nas sems bsrung 'bad par mdzod/ /gzhan yang dad pa zhing sa bzang po 'dra/ /'dod dgu 'byung zhing byang chub lo thog bskrun/ /'di phyir bde zhing rtag tu phan pa sgrub/ /da lta nyid nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ / gtong phod padma'i rdzing bu bzang po 'dra/ /dam pa 'du zhing skye bo dga' ba bskyed/ /bdog pa 'bras bcas longs spyod snying po yod/ /da lta nyid nas gzhan dag dga' bar mdzod/ /snyan par smra ba lha yi rnga sgra 'dra/ /'gro ba'i yid 'dzin mthong na mi mthun med/ /dul ba'i rjes 'gro dga' ba bskyed pas na/ /da lta nyid nas bstod pas mgu bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i spyod lam drang srong dam pa 'dra/ /mi dge 'gog cing 'gro ba'i dad pa 'phel/ /bcos ma'i tshul spongs rang bzhin dul ba'i ngang*/ /da lta nyid nas spyod yul phun tshogs mdzod/ /dam pa'i chos nyid bde gshegs dbang po 'dra/ /kun dang mthun zhing kun las khyad par 'phags/ /kun dang cha mthun kun dang mi 'dra bar/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /dal 'byor lus 'di sgyu ma'i khang bzang 'dra/ /re zhig snang yang nam 'jig nges pa med/ /tshe la long med 'dus kyang 'bral ba'i chos/ /da lta nyid nas yang yang dran par mdzod/ /longs spyod g.yo ba ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'byor pa'i rang bzhin gang du rgud pa'i chos/ /snying nas snying po med pa'i rang bzhin du/ /da lta nyid nas nges par rtogs par mdzod/ /'gro kun mi rtag snga phyi'i 'gron po 'dra/

/ rgan rabs sngon song gzhon rabs phyi nas 'gro/ /da lta'i rnams kyang lo brgyar gcig mi lus/ /da lta nyid nas nges par rtogs pa mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba de ring nyin gang 'dra/ /bar do'i snang ba do nub rmi lam tshul/ /phyi ma'i snang ba sang bzhin myur du 'ongs/ /da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /de ltar chos kun 'dra ba'i dpes bstan nas/ /yang cig dad ldan rnams la bskul ba ni/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba'i chos yin pas/ kho bo mi sdod thar pa'i gling du 'gro /'khor ba'i chos la yid brton 'ga' med pas/ /skye med chos sku'i gtan srid zin par mdzod/ /'jig rten snang ba sgyu ma'i bslu brid mkhan/ /brdzun pa'i rang bzhin sgeg mo g.yon can 'dra/ / dge las sems 'gro nyon mongs tshogs 'phel bas/ /ring du spongs te dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /chog shes med na 'byor yang dbul po ste/ /'jungs pa'i sems la khengs pa'i dus med do/ /chog shes ldan na 'byor pa'i yang rab yin/ /cung zad mchis la'ang bde bas sems gang ngo*/ /chang dang bud med nyon mongs 'byung khungs la/ /chags sred 'dun pa'i sems ni rab spangs te/ /drang srong rnams kyi spyod la rab gzhol nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su zhi ba'i don sgoms shig /nyin mtshan mi dal gcig tu sems dge ba/ / nyes spangs phan pa mdzad des gsungs bzhin du/ /skad cig ma yengs dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /'chi khar mi 'gyod ma 'ongs phan pa 'grub/ /yang cig yun ring las smon dag pa yis/ /chos dang dam tshig 'dres pa'i slob ma dag /'dus kyang 'bral ba'i chos te dpon slob gyes/ /tshong khang 'gron po 'dra bar mkhyen par mdzod/ /snying nas gcig tu phan pa'i gtam smras pa/ / yul dang longs spyod mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun sogs/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi kun spangs la/ /zhi ba'i gnas su bsam gtan bsgom par mdzod/ /cis kyang mi phan 'gro ba'i dus byung tshe/

/'chi khar mi 'jigs dam pa'i chos dgos pas/ /bla ma'i man ngag zab don snying po'i chos/ /da lta nyid nas goms shing brtson par mdzod/ /kun gyi nang nas 'od gsal snying po'i chos/ /kun gyi snying po snying thig gsang ba'i don/ /kun las mchog gyur tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam/ /kun bzang bde chen bsgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /gzhan yang zab don bdud rts-i'i snying po can/ /dam pa rnams las brgyud pa'i chos btsal te/ /brtson pa'i stobs kyis gcig pur nyams su longs/ / myur du rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /da lta nyid nas bde mchog kun 'grub cing*/ /phyi ma'i dus la'ang phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /mthong dang ma mthong che ba'i yon tan can/ /snying po'i don la deng nas brtson par mdzod/ /sprin bral zla ba gang ba'i tshogs gang ba/ /skar ma'i bdag po de yang 'char du nye/ /bla bre gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mang lhags pas mdzes gyur cing*/ /thugs rje mnga' ba'i mgon po padma'i zhal/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad pa de yi deng bzung bas/ / 'gro ba'i dus babs mgron po lam zhugs bzhin/ /'chi bas dga' ba'i rnyed pa legs grub pa/ /rgya mtsho'i don yongs grub pa'i tshong pa dang*/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbang dang*/ /bsam gtan grub pa'i bde bas ches lhag go /da ni mi sdod padma las 'brel rtsal/ /'chi med bde chen btsan sa 'dzin du 'gro /tshe zad las zad smon lam 'phan pa zad/ /'jig rten chos zad tshe 'di'i snang ba zad/ /bar do'i yul la zhing snang rgya che bas/ /rang snang ngo bo skad cig rang rig nas/ /gdod ma'i sa la gtan srid zin du nye/ / rang nyid 'byor pas gzhan nyid blo bde ba/ /sbrul pa'i skye bas thar gling phan pa bsgrub/ /de dus slob ma'i dam pa khyed rnams dang*/ /phrad nas chos kyi dga' bas tshim par smon/ /da res tshe 'di'i 'brel ba de las med/ /phyogs med sprang po gang bder shi ba la/

/mya ngan ma byed rgyun du gsol ba thobs/ / de skad phan par smra ba'i snying gi gtam/ /dad ldan bung ba dga' skyed padma'i sprin/ /legs smras dge bas 'gro ba khams gsum po/ /gdod ma'i sa la mya ngan 'das par shog

/zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ /dri med 'od zer gyis gdams pa rdzogs so// //bkra shis so/ / zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8) -PAGE 202--PAGE 203--PAGE 195-
